aboutData.title: Welcome to My Portfolio
aboutData.subtitle: Software Engineer
aboutData.text: Security-focused Software Engineer with 3.5+ years of professional experience in software engineering, backend systems, SaaS architecture, Linux production environments, and technical leadership, transitioning into a dedicated Cybersecurity career. Hands-on experience in web/API security testing, network traffic analysis, Linux server security investigation, malware hunting, vulnerability assessment, and secure software engineering using Wireshark, Nmap, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, SQLMap and Linux security tools. Currently working on an AI-powered malware detection and security agent using the EMBER dataset, Python, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM and FastAPI. Strong understanding of how real-world web applications, APIs, databases, and Linux infrastructure are designed, deployed and secured. Managed 100+ software projects, coordinated 20+ concurrent projects, led teams of up to 35 members, and contributed to approximately $80K+ in revenue within 9 months.

informations.title: Eclipse POS
informations.subTitle: POS and ERP Solution
informations.description: Eclipse POS is a robust point-of-sale system with over 15 modules, including inventory management, sales tracking, accounting, and courier integration. Built with Laravel, React, and MySQL, it features barcode generation via TCPDF, full-text search with Elasticsearch, and Redis caching for performance. I led end-to-end development, designed scalable database schemas, and guided junior developers to ensure seamless deployment for multi-branch operations.

informations.title: Glowthentic
informations.subTitle: E-commerce Platform
informations.description: Glowthentic is a modern e-commerce platform powered by Laravel backend and React frontend with Inertia.js. It offers product variants and dynamic attribute system, secure API integrations with courier services, and user tracking for analytics. I architected the system, developed APIs using Laravel Sanctum, and optimized performance with caching. The platform ensures a seamless shopping experience with responsive Tailwind CSS designs and robust testing via Postman.

informations.title: Accountant
informations.subTitle: ERP for Accounting
informations.description: Accountant ERP is a comprehensive solution for business management, featuring modules for accounting, inventory, CRM, and asset tracking. Built with Laravel and MySQL, it includes print-ready reports via Laravel DomPDF and role-based access with Spatie Permission. I designed the database and business logic, implemented complex features, and mentored junior developers to deliver a scalable, secure system for efficient operations.

informations.title: Eduvoyage
informations.subTitle: Education Consultancy Website
informations.description: Eduvoyage is a dynamic website for an education consultancy, featuring service listings, admission forms, and client management tools. Developed with Laravel, MySQL, and Tailwind CSS, it ensures responsive design and secure data handling. I led requirement analysis, database design, and development, integrating user-friendly interfaces and SEO optimization to enhance visibility and client engagement for educational services.

informations.title: Sobrokom
informations.subTitle: E-commerce Platform
informations.description: Sobrokom is a Laravel-based e-commerce platform with modules for product management, order tracking, and reporting. It leverages MySQL for data storage, Tailwind CSS for responsive design, and cron jobs for automation. I designed the backend architecture, optimized performance with caching, and integrated user analytics to enhance the shopping experience, ensuring scalability and reliability for high-traffic online stores.

informations.title: Other Projects
informations.subTitle: Miscellaneous Solutions
informations.description: Developed various web solutions like Zofer ERP and Wonderxfans, focusing on custom PHP, AJAX, and Shopify integrations. These projects include task management tools, e-commerce customizations, and performance optimizations. I contributed to backend logic, database design, and theme customization, delivering tailored solutions to meet diverse client needs while ensuring scalability and user-friendly interfaces.
